title: Handmade horns and his collection of cornets
summary: Handmade horns, each with its own sound, and manufacturers sending him horns such as the Getzen and the TV 'Magic Horn'.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: I think there are a couple of other technical questions that we might ask you. One is that when you say that this man made the horn for you, is it a handcrafted instrument?

Oh yes. Yes, he was, he's passed away now, but it's hand made definitely. And I've had that ever since 1943, 1943 that's right. But I just have it fixed all the time. But he was a beautiful, dedicated musician and so what do you want to know, something technical?
Well just one other question. Would you say that each horn has its own sound?

man or a trumpeter or a cornet player will know that low C Sharps, C Sharp and D and even the E they are a little bit sharp and you have to favor them. You have to slide the thing out here and tried it out. But this one is beautifully made and is very well in tune. And I've found, I've got a new Getzen now, they sent me a new Getzen and I find that, that's what I'm blowing now along with the Benge, I'm blowing the Getzen horn and it's beautifully in tune. No low register there.
And also in low register and medium register and high register.
In other words, the way I get books from publishers, you get horns from the music makers really. You have a collection of them huh?
It's just like a, oh, yes. Yes, I do.

I've got a, let's see, I have the Getzen. Now what's the other one that I got when I did the show on TV, 'The Magic Horn'. Oh, it's terrible, I can't think of names right now. Let's see what was it, ah, it's a French horn. What's the name
of it? I can't think of it. But I have another horn that they gave me when I did the television show on NBC called 'The Magic Horn'.

Oh about ten years ago I would say. Mostly acting there was very little playing. But yes, they do send me horns and they say a horn, Getzen (Getzen?) horn used by Jimmy McPartland and so on and so forth. You know and Benge horn or (Bach?) horn. And I think it's terrible. Do you ever get a mental block and you forget the name of a horn?
Oh yes and sometimes I almost forget my own name. (LAUGHTER).
